title: Jam Actor Levels
description: Canonical world level-content document resolved by world_archetypes.actor_level_name through shared_data_manifest.content.actor_level_set.

actor_id.description: Canonical generation-1 ActorId shared by server and client.

actor_archetype.description: Canonical actor archetype name resolved from the ActorArchetypeAsset document.

spawn_pose.description: Authored spawn pose for this level actor.

scene_name.description: Optional scene/presentation label carried with the actor level document.

instances.description: Stable authored level actors. Each instance resolves actor_archetype into ActorArchetypeAsset, then into a physics archetype at runtime.
